changeinfo.changes: Embark on a grand adventure starring the gilded goon himself, King Knight!

Play an all new prequel adventure starring the shadowy scythe-spinner, Specter Knight! Change characters from male to female, or vice versa in Body Swap Mode! Available in Shovel Knight's campaign. Listen and enjoy the music of Shovel Knight in Sound Test Mode!
Added game card information to the Instruction Booklet.
Play as the explosive trickster Plague Knight with new story and gameplay! Prove your mettle in Challenge Mode. Take on speed run challenges, boss rematches, and more!
